firm_data.firm_description: Danziger & Markhoff LLP is a business and tax-oriented law firm in White Plains, New York that has been representing clients in the New York metropolitan area for over 45 years. The firm's core areas of practice are pension and employee benefits, ESOPs, trusts and estates and tax planning, probate, corporate law and healthcare and professional practices.
notable_facts: The firm has a full-service pension administration department including four full-time enrolled actuaries.
The firm works closely with accountants and financial advisors using a team approach to identify clients' goals and produce practical and comprehensive business solutions.

email.subject: AI for Danziger & Markhoff, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Debbie,

Managing pension administration with four full-time enrolled actuaries is a significant operational asset, and it's the kind of specialized expertise that often gets bogged down by repetitive compliance work. That's where we help.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
